data.name: Ghaythah
data.gender_notes: Ghaythah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ghaythah means a rain cloud that brings life-giving water to the parched earth. It is derived from the Arabic word 'ghayth' which means the rain that falls from clouds. The name Ghaythah carries the meaning “A Rain Cloud” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ghaythah usually hope their child will grow to embody a rain cloud and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name carries the spiritual significance of nourishment and life-giving energy. It is a reminder of the blessings of Allah and the sustenance that comes from the heavens.
data.etymology: Ghaythah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A Rain Cloud.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaythah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: غيثه
in_arabic.meaning: غيثه تعني المطر أو الغيث الذي يأتي بعد الجفاف
in_arabic.long_meaning: غيثه اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'غَیْثَ' الذي يعني المطر أو الغيث الذي يأتي بعد الجفاف، ويرمز إلى الفرج بعد الشدة والرخاء بعد الضيق. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2، حيث يقول الله تعالى: 'وَهُوَ الَذِي يُرْسِلُ الغُيُوثَ فَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِهَا أَرْضًا مَّا أَخَذَت مِنهُ شَیْئًا تَرَکَهَا مُهَزَّلَةً'.

in_urdu.name: غيثہ
in_urdu.meaning: غيثہ کا مطلب ہے بارش یا وہ غيث جو خشک سالی کے بعد آتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: غيثہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بارش یا وہ غيث جو خشک سالی کے بعد آتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان میں 'غَیْثَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ قرآن کریم میں سورة الفرقان الآية 2 میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ اس نام کا انتخاب کرنے والوں کے لئے یہ ایک शुभ نام ہے کیونکہ یہ فرج کے بعد سختی اور خوشحالی کے بعد تنگی کا اشارہ کرتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: ग़ैथा
in_hindi.meaning: ग़ैथा का अर्थ है बारिश या सूखे के बाद आने वाला बारिश
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़ैथा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है, जिसका अर्थ है बारिश या सूखे के बाद आने वाला बारिश। यह नाम अरबी भाषा में 'غَیْثَ' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जो कुरआन में सूरा अल-फुरकान आयत 2 में उल्लेखित है। यह नाम चुनने वालों के लिए एक शुभ नाम है क्योंकि यह कठिनाई के बाद राहत और सुख के बाद तंगी का संकेत करता है।

in_pashto.name: غيثه
in_pashto.meaning: غيثه د باران يا د وريځو د راتلو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: غيثه يو ښځينه نوم دی چي د عربي کلمو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، د باران يا د وريځو د راتلو معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه 'غَیْثَ' فعل څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چي په قرآن کريم کې يې سوره الفرقان آيت 2 کې يادونه کړې ده. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره ښه دی چي دا انتخابوي، ځکه دا د ستونزو د حل او د آسانۍ د راتلو دلالت کوي.

in_english.name: Ghaythah
in_english.meaning: Ghaythah means rain or shower that comes after a dry spell
in_english.long_meaning: Ghaythah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'غَیْثَ' (ghaytha), which means to rain or to send down rain. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Furqan, Verse 2. The name symbolizes relief and prosperity after a period of hardship or drought. In Islamic tradition, Ghaythah is considered a blessed name, signifying hope and renewal.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghaythah is considered as a symbol of relief and sustenance in Muslim culture. It is often used to describe a person who brings about a positive change or a solution to a problem, just like the rain cloud that revitalizes the earth.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Ghaythah represents the divine mercy and compassion of Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Allah sends down the clouds, and He does not send them down except in obedience to Himself; and He sends down rain and snow, and He does not send them down except in obedience to Himself. He causes the clouds to settle between the earth and the sky, and then He sends down water and hails. Allah sends it down in accordance with His knowledge, and He sends it down plentifully on certain lands and sparingly on others. Verily, the sustenance of Allah is tomorrow (for the people of Paradise) and the very next moment (for those in Hell)." (Ahmad)
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ghaythah in Arabic means "a heavy shower of rain from the sky." It symbolizes the outpouring of God's mercy and blessings, providing relief and renewal in times of hardship and drought. In Islamic context, it also refers to a Prophet (as) mentioned in Hadith, who will bring divine retribution against injustice and oppression before the Day of Judgment.
